description: This file defines the SchedulerMigrationResult class, which encapsulates the outcome of a scheduler migration operation within the SuiteCRM project. It includes static methods to create success, skip, and error results, along with methods to query the result status and string representation.

classes.name: SchedulerMigrationResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a scheduler migration, including success status, action taken, message, and details such as number of schedulers found and updated.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of SchedulerMigrationResult with specified properties.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Creates a result indicating the migration was skipped due to no legacy schedulers found.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Creates a successful migration result, either in dry run mode or actual migration.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Creates an error result, optionally including exception details.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Returns whether the migration was successful.

methods.name: hasSchedulers
methods.description: Indicates whether any schedulers were found during migration.

methods.name: isDryRun
methods.description: Checks if the result corresponds to a dry run.

methods.name: wasSkipped
methods.description: Checks if the migration was skipped.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing the migration result, including status, action, message, and additional details.
